**Every clip now keeps the site's own media.**

Artspo 0.9.0 saves what a page shows, not just what it measures. Each clip gets an `assets/` folder with the page's icons and logo as SVG, its images, short videos, and Lottie or Rive animations. Each file is described by how the page uses it: an icon set as "line icons on a 24×24 grid, stroke 1.5px, round caps", a hero as "object-fit cover, radius 24px". Lottie files are read for their exact keyframes and easing curves.

Media comes from what the page already loaded, out of Chrome's cache. Artspo only requests a file again when the cache no longer has it, plus the page's share image. Nothing is sent anywhere.

### What you get

- **SVGs** with their real colors filled in and sprite icons resolved, named by role (logo, icon, illustration).
- **Images** with their treatment: fit, radius, filter, blend, mask.
- **Video** saved whole, even when the page streamed it in pieces.
- **Lottie and Rive**, plus favicon and share image. Fonts are listed by where they come from, not saved.
- **Under Media in clip.md**, and as a Media grid in the catalogue.
- **Size limits:** 60 MB per clip in all. Anything skipped is listed with the reason.

Books never include saved media. The public edition strips it, along with any mention of it.

### Updating

`git pull`, click ↻ on Artspo in `chrome://extensions`, then run `sh install.sh` so your agent's skill knows about `assets/`. Clips you already have get media the next time you press ↻ on them.

### Files

- `artspo-0.9.0.zip`: the whole repo (extension, skill, MCP server, docs). Use this one.
- `artspo-extension-0.9.0.zip`: just the `extension/` folder, the Chrome Web Store upload.

Requires Chrome 118+ on macOS (Linux works; Windows isn't supported). [5-minute tutorial](https://github.com/bryfeng/artspo/blob/main/docs/TUTORIAL.md) · [artbook.dev](https://artbook.dev/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=artspo)
